QuestInfo.name: Bait for the Fatal Trap
QuestInfo.0: Go to #p3000003# and get the Magic Amplifier.
QuestInfo.2: You and your allies were able to deal a decisive blow to Magnus just as you planned, giving the Magic Amplifier to #p3000000#.

0.0: Ah, Kaiser! #p3000001# told me all about your plan. It's just crazy enough to work! Here, this is the Magic Amplifier. It runs off of Magic Pebbles near Pantheon. Would you like to take it?

yes.0: If this works, we'll have the perfect opportunity to counterattck into Heliseum. Of course, if we fail, we lose everything, but we can't get hung up on details! Here, take this to #p3000000#. And good luck!

no.0: Not ready yet? I understand. After all, if you mess this up, Pantheon is done for. That's a lot of pressure, y'know.

1.0: So, this plan is your doing? You're mad, Kaiser. Perhaps just mad enough to win us this battle. We're not going to win just by sitting here, are we?
1.1: Captain Piston will take the Magic Amplifier and drop it near the summoning square. Once we lower the Protective Shield, our enemies will surely use the device to summon the rest of their army.\r\n
1.2: This all depends on the summoners not smelling a trap. If this fails, my career's going to be shorter than my predecessors'. I'll focus on getting the Protective Shield back up in time.

yes.0: Well, this is it. May fortune smile on Nova...

npc.0: Take the Magic Amplifier to #p3000000# at Pantheon.

item.0: What, you lost it? How is that possible? (If you lost the item, forfeit the quest and accept it again.)
